components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Antique gold CTA for primary booking actions.
components.css: .btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background-color: #C9A45C; color: #08241C; font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; padding: 16px 28px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #C9A45C; min-height: 48px; transition: background-color 250ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .btn-primary:hover { background-color: #B5914A; }

components.name: Secondary Dark Button
components.description: Outlined gold CTA for WhatsApp and secondary actions on emerald grounds.
components.css: .btn-secondary-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background-color: transparent; color: #E3C88A; font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; padding: 16px 28px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #C9A45C; min-height: 48px; transition: background-color 250ms ease, color 250ms ease; } .btn-secondary-dark:hover { background-color: rgba(201, 164, 92, 0.1); color: #C9A45C; }

narrative.overview: Roop Nikhar's interface is built as a calm, unhurried boutique sanctuary alternating between deep botanical emerald rooms and warm daylight ivory salons, joined by crisp antique-gold hairlines. Flat tonal layering replaces heavy shadows and harsh gradients, while bilingual English/Hindi typography and 48px thumb-friendly targets serve mobile visitors in Motihari.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating deep emerald (#0B2E24) and warm ivory (#F7F2E8) section grounds
Flat tonal layering with 1px gold/emerald hairlines instead of harsh gradients
Bilingual Cormorant Garamond + Jost (EN) and Tiro Devanagari Hindi + Mukta (HI) parity
Soft 12px-24px architectural radii and 48px minimum button height

rules.name: Hindi Typography Protection
rules.body: Enforce font-weight: 400 on Hindi headings and letter-spacing: 0 across all html[lang="hi"] elements.

rules.name: Flat Surface Discipline
rules.body: Use flat emerald/ivory fills and subtle 1px hairlines instead of multi-stop gradients or neon glows.

dos: Do keep interactive buttons and nav targets at least 44px-48px tall.
Do use overflow-x: clip on html/body to preserve sticky header and ScrollTrigger behavior.
Do test both English and Hindi views after typography or layout changes.
donts: Don't introduce harsh gradients, neon colors, or off-palette gray text.
Don't apply letter-spacing or bold weights to Devanagari Hindi headings.
Don't use overflow-x: hidden on html or body.
